name: Pigment Liner Fineliner Set, Black, 8 Pens in Assorted Tip Sizes
bestUse: Best for captions, dates and fine details
descriptionOriginal: A box of eight black fineliners with pigment ink and a range of tip widths, from very fine to broad.
whyWeLikeIt: Captions and dates are what turn a collage into a diary, and one box gives you a fine tip for small notes and a broader one for headings. Staedtler describes the ink as pigment-based and waterproof on paper.
limitations: Staedtler's black box covers a wide range of widths, so a few tips will be finer or broader than most captions need. Waterproof is the maker's claim for writing on paper; as with most pens, try it on a glossy sticker before committing a page. Black only: this listing is not a colour set.
qualityNote: Customers say it is among their favourites and works well with watercolour. No concerns seen when checked.
specsEvidence: Staedtler Pigment Liner 308 black 8-box page, https://www.staedtler.com/nz/en/products/products-for-colouring/fineliners/pigment-liner-308-fineliner-308-sb8/ (read 2026-11-20): pigment ink, indelible, lightfast, waterproof on paper; 8-pen black box in assorted line widths (0.05 to 1.2 mm plus a 0.3-2.0 mm tip); can stay uncapped at least 12 hours. Regional box contents differ, so the exact US box is the one on the listing (8 black pens, assorted tips). 'Acid-free' appears only on retailer pages, not Staedtler's, and is not used. Amazon listing sold by Amazon.com, in stock, per Cowork 2026-11-19.
suitability: A black pigment-ink fineliner set for captions, dates and small handwriting in a first junk journal; not a colour set.
